finalLens.pull_quote: Your steadiness becomes useful again when the routine stops asking for more loyalty than it returns.
finalLens.deeper_read: You are the operator who checks whether a structure still serves the result. When a repeated sequence preserves confinement instead of reducing friction, loyalty can keep you inside it until your own needs are difficult to hear.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself completing the same rework-heavy step after identifying it as the friction point.
finalLens.move: Move that step later in tomorrow's schedule and note whether the routine requires fewer corrections.

parsedResponse.deeper_read: You turn possibility into bounded proof because loyalty guides your decisions and steadiness needs something observable to hold. A reversible test keeps the opening close enough to assess without giving more than the test requires.
parsedResponse.watch_for: Watch for adding extra commitments before the reversible test has produced useful evidence.
parsedResponse.move: Set one review date and assess the offer only against the evidence gathered by then.
